title: Procedural Preview All Types
description: Extend procedural preview pipeline so point and vector outputs are rendered alongside geometry (curves, surfaces, solids). Unify into ProceduralPreviewItem model.
summary: Fixed 3D preview disappearing on any flow interaction. Root cause: pointer-up runs evaluate() then persistFixture(); evaluate updates output preview widget dicts, persistFixture syncs fixture via setFixtureJson which cleared previewItems after they were set. applyFixtureJson now only resets preview/selection when resetInteraction:true (fixture load/reset/preset); flow sync updates fixtureJson without clearing preview state.
